title: Moroccan Chicken Stir Fry
description: A flavorful and nutritious stir fry dish with the bold flavors of Moroccan spices.
instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add chicken and cook until browned, about 5-6 minutes.
Remove chicken from skillet and set aside.
Add sliced onion and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add bell peppers and cook until tender, about 4-5 minutes.
Return chicken to skillet and stir in moroccan spice blend and stir-fry sauce.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes or until chicken is cooked through.
Stir in sour lemon juice and season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
